shadows.name: operational-surface
shadows.purpose: Soft depth beneath primary console surfaces.

components.name: Primary Control
components.description: The currently available safe machine action.
components.css: .ds-primary-control { min-height: 50px; padding: 11px 14px; border: 1px solid #ffbd22; border-radius: 8px; background: #ffbd22; color: #171204; font: 600 14px system-ui; } .ds-primary-control:hover { background: #ffc83d; } .ds-primary-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffbd22; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: State Chip
components.css: .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; color: #a0a6ad; font: 700 12px system-ui; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-state i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #55d879; }

components.name: Machine Panel
components.description: A responsibility-sized console plane with fine structural seams.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #2b3036; border-radius: 12px; background: #101316; color: #f0f1f2; box-shadow: 0 18px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.32); } .ds-panel h2 { color: #a0a6ad; font: 700 11px system-ui; letter-spacing: .07em; } .ds-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #ffbd22; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Scythe is a purpose-built inspection station: quiet charcoal machine planes place the camera first, while amber appears only when operator attention or action is required.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained charcoal and amber material language

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Amber is operational signal, not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Instrument Type Rule
rules.body: Monospace belongs only to measurements that benefit from fixed-width comparison.

dos: Do let the latest camera frame dominate the first viewport.
Do show the slow update interval through timestamp, countdown, and linear cadence.
donts: Don't imply the camera is live video.
Don't turn every metric into an equal rounded card.
